scope: Pure TagDuel damage-redirection adapter for one Counter Trap; no resolver, catalog, certification, inventory or persistent-player mutation.

card.name: Barrel Behind the Door
card.officialEffect: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that would inflict damage to you: Your opponent takes the damage instead.

design.timing: Consumes a chain-resolution receipt for the Counter Trap activation and the source effect activation it responds to.
design.routing: The original damage recipient must be the Counter Trap controller's shared team LP; the plan redirects the exact amount to the opposing team's shared LP.
design.nonNegation: The source effect is not negated. The plan is a redirection directive; the source effect must resolve once and its damage must be applied once.
design.multipleCopies: Each distinct Counter Trap activation has its own idempotency key. Multiple directives referencing the same source effect are not additive damage; the chain resolver still applies that source effect once.
design.safety: Requires a Set face-down card that is face-up in the controller's backrow at resolution, valid physical UIDs, non-negated chain links, a positive unapplied damage amount and an exact shared LP snapshot.

plannedTests: Spell/Trap/monster activated effects redirect exact damage to the other team
symmetric routing for both teams and controller-vs-owner distinction
exclude battle damage, non-activated effects, no-damage and wrong recipient
require Set face-down and face-up Counter Trap resolution state
exclude negated/unresolved source or Counter Trap links
reject already-applied damage, malformed IDs/UIDs and stale LP snapshots
idempotent activation receipts and multiple copies without additive damage
preserve LP, private hands, decks, 3+3 zones, separate Field Zone and Extra Deck
